record.question: Which team wins the 2017 Santosh Trophy of Football?
record.explanation: AIFF's 26 March 2017 final report records West Bengal beating Goa to win the 71st Santosh Trophy. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.the-aiff.com/index.php/article/west-bengal-beat-goa-to-lift-record-32nd-santosh-trophy Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
